Sample
preparation
and
analysis :
All
samples
were
diluted
with

one
to
three
drops
of
distilled
water ,
homogenized
by
ultra
sound ,
and

then
spun
down
for
three
to
four
minutes
in
a
high
speed

microcentrifuge .
The
homogenates
were
absorbed
into
whatmans's
* 1

filter
paper ,
and
analyzed
using
horizontal
starch
gel
electrophoresis .

Gel
preparation
consisted
of
pouring
a
mixture
of
35
g
starch
( Sigma )

suspended
in
80
ml
of
cold
buffer
solution
into
220
ml
of
boiling

buffer
solution .
The
final
300ml
volume
was
mixed
vigorously ,

degassed ,
and
poured
into
17
cm
by
17
cm
by
1
cm
molds .
The
gels

were
cooled
to
4
degrees
C
before
loading
the
samples .
Enzymatic

activity
was
detected
at
the
following
loci :
phosphoglucoisomerase .

( Pgi - 1
and
Pgi - 2 ) ,
phosophoglucomutase
( Pgm ) ;
tetrazolium
oxidase

( To ) ,
hexokinase
( Hk - 1
and
HK - 2 ) ,
malate
dehydrogenase
( Mdh - 1
and

Mdh - 2 ) ,
malic
enzyme
( Me ) ,
acid
phosphotase
( Acp ) ,
and
xanthine

dehydrogenase
( Xdh ) .
Only
Pgi - 1 ,
Pgm ,
To ,
Hk - 2 ,
and
Mdh - 1
were

scored .
The
other
loci
were
either
not
resolved
well
enough
to
be

scorable ,
or ,
in
the
case
of
Hk - 1
and
Pgi - 2 ,
were
detectable
only
in

very
small
individuals .
